audit.whatIsWrong: Apprehend is this matchup's tracked ability and appeared in roughly a dozen fields without ever carrying its cooldown. It is 26 seconds at rank 1 — by far the longest cooldown in Darius's kit and the single biggest window in the lane.
audit.why: 'Track Apprehend' is unactionable; 'his pull is gone for 26 seconds' tells the player exactly how long the lane belongs to them. Decimate at 9s and Crippling Strike at 5s are the short ones you cannot wait out, which is why the E is the one to bait.
audit.corrected: 26s written into breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, early and mid, with Decimate's 9s alongside it.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two problems. (a) Four fields say Noxian Guillotine 'executes you through your W shield'. Riot's text describes lethal TRUE damage that scales with Hemorrhage stacks and refreshes its cooldown on a kill — there is no execute threshold, and true damage is still absorbed by Titan's Wrath, so 'through your shield' is wrong. (b) Apprehend's passive is never mentioned anywhere: it makes Darius's physical damage ignore a percentage of the target's armour. Against a Nautilus whose entire plan is stacking resistances, that is the most important line in his kit.
audit.why: A player told his shield does nothing against the ult will refuse fights he could take; a player who does not know his E shreds armour will keep buying the stat that Darius partially ignores and wonder why 'even' trades lose.
audit.corrected: Guillotine restated as true damage that grows per bleed stack and refreshes on a kill; the shield claim removed. Apprehend's armour-shred passive written into dontsFull[1].d and early. Hemorrhage's five-stack enrage — massive attack damage — written into dontsFull[2].d, which previously carried unrelated boilerplate under the title 'Fight at 5 stacks'.

audit.whatIsWrong: Three chart rows contradicted their own whys: whys[2] says Darius 'out-trades you through it' under a 'Skill' token; whys[5] literally opens 'Skill window' under 'Darius'; whys[6] says 'this is the one stage you flip' under 'Darius'.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is Darius/Darius/Darius/Darius/Skill/Skill/Nautilus, matching all seven whys, and the packet lists no defects here.
audit.corrected: Rows 2, 5 and 6 set to the packet values in BOTH layers as matched pairs, with ratings adjusted to match.

edits.before: Darius owns these levels and there is no spinning it — his E pulls me right into the outer-ring sweet spot of his Q before my W shield even exists, and his Hemorrhage bleed out-DPSes my tank stats. My passive root and Q pull look like answers, but every time I commit my Q he just E-pulls me back, stacks five bleeds, and his empowered Q shreds me. Last-hit with E Riptide shockwaves from max range, never walk into his Q outer ring, and save Q to drag myself onto a wall to escape, not to start a fight I lose.
edits.after: Darius owns these levels and there is no spinning it — Apprehend pulls me right into the blade half of his Q before my W shield exists, and it passively shreds my armour on top of that. My passive root and Q pull look like answers, but every time I commit my Q he just E-pulls me back, stacks five bleeds, and his empowered Q shreds me. Last-hit with Riptide shockwaves from max range, never step inside 535 while Apprehend is up, and save Q to drag myself onto a wall to escape, not to start a fight I lose.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 stay his — my W shield and E scale but they don't fix that he out-trades me through bleed and resets with Guillotine. At 6 it finally levels off: my Depth Charge knock-up can interrupt his Q wind-up and lock him for a gank, but heads-up his R executes me through my shield if I'm low. Don't solo all-in him at 6; instead use the R as gank setup and bait his E cooldown before I ever step up. This is a skill window, not a kill window.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 stay his — my W shield and E scale but they don't fix that he out-trades me through bleed and resets with Guillotine. At 6 it finally levels off: my Depth Charge knock-up can interrupt his Decimate wind-up and lock him for a gank, but heads-up his R's true damage climbs with every Hemorrhage stack on me. Don't solo all-in him at 6; use the R as gank setup and bait his 26-second Apprehend before I ever step up. This is a skill window, not a kill window.

edits.before: This is the one stage I reclaim. Once I'm on full tank — Hollow Radiance, Jak'Sho, Thornmail — his Hemorrhage bleed stops out-pacing my durability and his item damage plateaus while mine never mattered. In a straight 1v1 I now outlast his bleed and my CC chain (Q pull, R knock-up, E slow, passive root) locks him for the team. Don't 1v1 him before this point, but late I peel and engage, and his execute threshold gets a lot harder to reach.

notes: This entry was already well above the average — real ability names, the blade-versus-handle rule, the five-stack enrage. Two substantive corrections: Noxian Guillotine was described four times as executing 'through your W shield', which is wrong on both counts (no execute threshold in Riot's text, and shields do absorb true damage); and Apprehend's passive armour penetration was never mentioned anywhere, despite being the reason a tank Nautilus cannot simply out-stack him. Apprehend's 26-second rank-1 cooldown was likewise absent from every one of the dozen fields that told the player to track it. NOT asserted: whether Depth Charge's knock-up can interrupt Noxian Guillotine's leap (the page already claims it interrupts the Decimate wind-up, which is a wind-up in Riot's own text, so that one stands). Sample is 21 games at 42.86%.
